# `deposits.term_deposit.InterestAccrued`

Interest accrued for the period. For AT_MATURITY this is the single flow at maturity. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); no PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2).

## Payload fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `gross_interest_cents` | `long` | GrossInterest as integer EUR cents (Money.Cents). |
| `as_of` | `int` (`date`) | AsOf (DateOnly) as days since epoch. |

## Governing ADRs

[ADR-IC-002](../../integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md), [ADR-PC-004](../../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md)
